finalists.label: Kawasaki disease
finalists.why: The candidate has the most specific findings, including bilateral nonpurulent conjunctivitis, erythematous throat, palmar erythema, a strawberry tongue, and an erythema multiforme–type rash.

finalists.label: Toxic shock syndrome
finalists.why: The candidate has a strong set of findings, including fever, abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, erythematous throat, palmar erythema, a strawberry tongue, and an erythema multiforme–type rash, although the absence of hypotension is a notable exception.

frontier_selector.why: The evidence of bilateral nonpurulent conjunctivitis, erythematous throat, palmar erythema, a strawberry tongue, and an erythema multiforme–type rash, along with elevated CRP and ESR, decided the final comparison in favor of Kawasaki disease.
